title: UCOS Contract — Request Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for an operation request contract. Body/parameter field-level schemas are OPTIONAL and referenced (never inlined/invented), because UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 defines no field-level request schemas. Transport-neutral, implementation-neutral.

declared.description: true when a concrete request body/parameter schema is defined; false when deferred/absent.

pathParameters.description: OPTIONAL. Path parameters surfaced from the path template; TYPES deferred unless defined.

queryParameters.description: OPTIONAL query parameters; TYPES deferred unless defined.

bodyRef.description: Reference to the request body schema (a payload family) OR a placeholder when the field schema is not defined in the catalog.

$comment: Additive evolution only. All field-level detail is OPTIONAL and reference-based. No implementation-specific fields (no content-type, no serialization, no framework binding).
